summary: NewGenIvf Group filed a 6-K disclosing a board-approved reverse stock split at a 1-for-4 ratio covering Class A, Class B and preferred shares. Effective 12:01 a.m. ET October 12, 2026, Class A shares trade split-adjusted on Nasdaq under symbol NIVF and new CUSIP G0544E600, reducing roughly 35,688,329 Class A shares to about 8,922,083. No shareholder vote is required under BVI law; fractional shares round up to one share; options and warrants adjust proportionally. No special-situation transaction is implicated.
